violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: Raw beef was attempting to be thawed by being left at room temperature on prep table.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. EHS DISCUSSED THE 3 PROPER WAYS OF THAWING FOOD CORRECTLY. PIC MOVED RAW BEEF INTO REFRIGERATOR TO KEEP THAWING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Cooked bacon was begin stored on top of old egg cartons to cool in the food prep and cooking areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT ALL FOODS NEED TO BE PROPERLY STORED WHILE COOLING IN A WAY THAT WILL NOT CONTAMINATE IT. PIC MOVED BACON TO A SHEET TRAY TO COOL IN A NON CONTAMINATED WAY.
